notes.title: Chordwatch update 1.0.4!
notes.content:
Hello all,

It's been a good few months since the release of Chordwatch on Steam! It has been great to see more people using the app.

With the recent release of Update 1.0.4, bugs have been fixes, chords database updated and a official User Guide created.

===Changes===
- Fixed some MIDI Keyboards getting 'stuck keys' when played in the app. Now all notes should release!
- Fixed support button sometimes not working.
- Updated Chords database.
- User Guide pinned to Store page.
==============

The new User Guide can be accessed via the Store page, or [url=https://chordwatch.com/ChordwatchUserGuide.pdf]here directly[/url]!

I hope it gives light to all the features available in Chordwatch.

Thanks again for supporting Chordwatch.

All the best,
Tom
